podcast.body: A top five hit that Thomas Dolby scored under his own name, following his early career boost from Mut Lang who brought him in as a session player for Foreigner's "Waiting for a Girl Like You." "Thomas Dolby, who would later score hits of his own, like the 1983 top five hit she blinded me with science."

podcast.body: This single from Thomas Dolby's 1982 debut album, "The Golden Age of Wireless," received immense exposure through "endless rotation" on MTV. It was accompanied by Thomas Dolby's distinct "mad scientist" persona, featuring a white lab coat, wild hair, and an array of complex electronic gear, which further solidified his nerdy image. "He had this mad scientist persona complete with the white lab coat and crazy hair, surrounded by all kinds of complex electronics gear."
